hypothesis: Synthetic-pretrained tabular in-context regression supplies a distinct prior on the fixed37-feature train-label context.

checkpoint.network_scope: JSON metadata only; no checkpoint download

inputs.training_context: Exactly existing selected/purged4096-per-airport train rows, no resampling; per-airport context only.
inputs.query_population: All175288 existing April input rows, original canonical order; no outcome filtering before prediction.
inputs.preprocessing: Raw37 DataFrame; categorical fields explicit object strings with original missing semantics. Native per-airport train-only preprocessing and target StandardScaler. No inherited retrieval encoder/scaler arrays, no query fit, no extra features.
inputs.audit_reuse: Reuse existing independent input audit/recovery; do not reimplement raw feature or selection audit.

model.prediction: native mean; fixed R=max(0,np.rint(mean)) for loss comparison
model.tail_caveat: Native mean averages999 interior predicted quantiles; it is not analytical exponential-tail integration. No tail correction, quantile choice or output calibration.

preflight.scope: No April labels; first32 input-hash queries of largest context airport (ties lexicographic), plus first256 for capacity. Compare cached/uncached, repeated, single/chunked/permuted mean and native999 quantiles under same fitted preprocessing; poison/drop target fields must not enter actual37 projection.
preflight.failure_policy: Close as resource/numerical infeasible under this fixed configuration; no alternative cache/precision/ensemble/context/encoder/target policy selected after failure. No prediction-quality selection.
preflight.unresolved: Actual dependency compatibility, checkpoint config and host capacity are not yet validated; no claim of runtime or cache equivalence.

evaluation.reuse: Both fixed retrieval arms if their completed predictions and independent audits pass; no new fits. If either unavailable, comparison is incomplete and cannot advance.
evaluation.truth_firewall: All TabICL April predictions and inference/input bindings saved and independently checked before TabICL scoring. Designer has read no April outcomes.
evaluation.primary: Same serialized all-finite-target April RMSE and same population as existing retrieval scoring.
evaluation.gate: At least1.0second RMSE improvement versus EACH fixed retrieval control AND paired UTC-day95% bootstrap upper<0 against EACH; no airport/month subsetting.
evaluation.secondary: Airport losses/negative-native counts/extreme-target errors are descriptive only; no retuning.
evaluation.interpretation: This is mechanism evidence against two fixed practical controls, not an isolated matched architecture effect or selected-v80 gain.
evaluation.successor: Only after pass may root freeze a genuine Jan/Jul model/current-parent comparison with all leakage controls and complete final capability. No candidate from April alone.

environment.plan: Separate environment with exact current numerical-runtime pins, direct missing dependency pins from metadata plan; root-authorized dry-run must resolve and hash-lock ALL transitive wheels before install. Build exact package commit into recorded wheel; disable auto model downloads.
